season.source: NOAA SFBOFS (San Francisco Bay Operational Forecast System), NOAA Open Data on AWS. What happened is stitched from the first six hours of each six-hourly cycle.

forecast.source: SFBOFS 21z cycle of 14 Jul 2024, as issued.

terrain.source: Terrarium elevation tiles (Mapzen, AWS Open Data).

wind.note: The wind SFBOFS was driven with, in tenths of a metre per second, blowing toward east (u) and north (v).

tide.note: Water level in metres above the model datum, close to mean sea level.
